review_candidates.title: Director/a General
review_candidates.description: Desde Fritz&Muller estamos trabajando para una compañía especializada en la Producción y Gestión Integral de Eventos referente de su sector. Estamos en búsqueda de su próximo/a Director/a General . Funciones principales: Asumir la dirección integral de la compañía, con responsabilidad plena sobre la cuenta de resultados y el control de márgenes, costes y EBITDA. Diseñar e implementar el plan estratégico y el presupuesto anual, alineando los objetivos de la propiedad con los resultados operativos y económicos. Liderar el crecimiento del negocio corporativo B2B , gestionando la captación y negociación de cuentas estratégicas y la relación con clientes, agencias y partners clave. Definir la política comercial (objetivos, tarifas y márgenes mínimos) e implantar una metodología de venta con CRM y seguimiento del pipeline. Garantizar la coordinación efectiva entre las áreas Comercial y Producción , asegurando la ejecución de cada proyecto conforme a los estándares de calidad, plazo y rentabilidad previstos. Establecer un sistema de control económico por proyecto, así como la optimización de la planificación y utilización de recursos y equipamiento técnico. Dirigir y desarrollar a los responsables de área, definiendo roles, objetivos y niveles de decisión que fomenten un equipo autónomo y orientado a resultados. Impulsar la profesionalización de la organización mediante la documentación de procesos, cuadros de mando y reporting periódico a la propiedad. Requisitos: Experiencia profesional de entre 7 y 10 años, con trayectoria en posiciones de Dirección General, Dirección de Unidad de Negocio o Dirección de Operaciones. Trayectoria acreditada en la gestión de cuenta de resultados y en el liderazgo de equipos comerciales y operativos. Experiencia en entornos de servicios o proyectos de operativa compleja; se valorará el sector eventos, producción audiovisual o agencias. Sólida capacidad de desarrollo de negocio B2B y de negociación con clientes y proveedores estratégicos. Experiencia en la implantación de procesos, CRM y herramientas de control de gestión, con manejo avanzado de presupuestos e indicadores. Formación universitaria en ADE, Economía, Ingeniería o afines; se valorará MBA o formación complementaria en dirección de operaciones. Perfil con orientación a resultados, capacidad de ejecución y presencia en la operativa del negocio; se valorará experiencia previa en empresas familiares o procesos de transformación organizativa. Qué ofrecemos: Incorporación a una posición de máxima responsabilidad, con dependencia directa de la propiedad y participación en las decisiones estratégicas, comerciales y de inversión. Un proyecto en crecimiento, con objetivos definidos de consolidación y expansión nacional. Autonomía y capacidad real de decisión para liderar la transformación y profesionalización de la compañía.

review_candidates.title: Customer Support Analyst
review_candidates.description: Help make the world more hospitable The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that's just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we're transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences. You'll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You'll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you'll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we're building. If you're motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you'll feel at home here. About the role Let's get into the specifics. It's impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this: When a hotel can't check guests in or a payment fails, you're the person they reach, and you own it until it's fixed. Mews runs the operations of thousands of properties worldwide, connected to payments, POS and dozens of integrations, so you'll build deep knowledge of the full platform fast, and that knowledge is a direct route into senior Support, Onboarding or Product. What you'll be doing Owning around 30 cases a day across chat, email and phone, often with two or three live conversations at once, and resolving them end to end within SLA Investigating across account history, workflow configuration and integrations to find the real cause, and proposing a fix rather than escalating by default Redesigning how your casework runs with AI, building triage and drafting approaches teammates can reuse, and always checking the output against the customer's actual setup Turning patterns into knowledge base updates and clean Jira tickets for Product and Engineering, with reproducible steps and impact AI Fluency Level 3: you've moved past using AI for personal speed. In this role you rethink how investigation and drafting get done, build approaches the rest of the team can follow, and question what the AI gives you rather than passing it on. For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to "AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates". What we're looking for 1 to 3 years in tech support (SaaS, hotel tech or payments), ideally with PMS, POS or payments exposure Experience in a high-volume, live-chat queue with measurable targets such as FCR and AHT A root-cause habit and the composure to explain technical issues in plain language to a stressed front desk AI Fluency Level 3 or the equivalent hands-on experience. What's in it for you? Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive. Global benefits No matter where you're based, you'll enjoy: Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really) Participation in our company share program Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service) An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year Relocation options, available after one year Flexible, hybrid working options A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working Local benefits You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

review_candidates.title: Country Manager, Nordic Markets
review_candidates.description: Medison is a rapidly growing global pharmaceutical company with a strong global presence, operating in 5 continents and over 34 countries. Our mission is to provide access to highly innovative therapies to patients who suffer mainly from cancer and rare diseases, in many international markets. If you are passionate about making a difference and want to be part of our mission, join us! We are seeking an experienced, entrepreneurial, and commercially minded Country Manager to lead our affiliate in Denmark/Sweden and drive long-term business growth, organizational excellence, and sustainable value creation. As the senior Medison leader in the market, the Country Manager serves as the face of the company externally and the integrator of all affiliate activities internally. The role carries full accountability for business performance, patient impact, financial outcomes, organizational capability, strategic partnerships, compliance, and reputation. Beyond delivering short-term results, the successful candidate will demonstrate enterprise leadership by balancing local market opportunities with broader regional and global priorities, developing strategic partnerships, building a high-performing organization, and creating the conditions for sustainable long-term growth. The role requires strong commercial judgment, executive presence, business gravitas, financial discipline, and the ability to lead through ambiguity in a dynamic and evolving healthcare environment. The position reports to the Cluster Head and is based in Denmark/Sweden. Domestic and international travel should be expected. Responsibilities: Enterprise Leadership, Strategy & Growth Define and execute the affiliate strategy in alignment with Medison's global and regional objectives while adapting to local market realities and opportunities. Drive long-term sustainable growth by identifying market opportunities, anticipating risks, and making strategic investment decisions that maximize enterprise value. Act as the architect of the affiliate's growth agenda, ensuring a balance between short-term performance delivery and long-term capability building. Build robust business cases for portfolio expansion, launches, partnerships, and strategic investments as needed based on global and BD requirements. Lead scenario planning and strategic forecasting, proactively identifying future market developments and competitive threats. Foster enterprise thinking across the leadership team, ensuring decisions are made in the best interests of patients, employees, partners, and Medison as a whole. Financial Accountability & Business Performance Maintain full ownership and accountability for affiliate P&L performance and delivery of financial commitments. Ensure disciplined allocation of financial and human resources based on strategic priorities, ROI, and long-term value creation. Lead annual strategic planning, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation processes. Drive transparency, rigor, and accountability in financial forecasting, ensuring assumptions are validated, pressure-tested, and supported by robust market intelligence. Establish a culture where leaders understand not only performance outcomes but also the underlying business drivers and investment implications. Continuously optimize organizational resources, investments, and operating expenses to maximize business performance. Cross functional Excellence, Market Access & Portfolio Operational Execution Lead execution of commercial, medical, and market access strategies to maximize patient access and business outcomes at local level. Align Commercial, Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, Market Development, Compliance, Finance, HR, Pharmacovigilance, and Supply Chain organizations around common priorities. Drive portfolio prioritization and lifecycle management decisions based on market insights, patient needs, competitive intelligence, and financial considerations at local level. Oversee Business Units’ customer engagement strategies and ensure strong execution across all channels and stakeholder groups. Ensure operational excellence across all affiliate activities and maintain high standards of execution. Ensure successful launch readiness and launch execution for new products and indications at local level. Monitor healthcare policy developments, market changes, and reimbursement dynamics and translate insights into actionable business strategies. Drive cross-functional decision making, removing organizational barriers and accelerating business outcomes. Ensure appropriate governance, forecasting accuracy, supply continuity, and execution discipline across all business processes. Partnership Management & External Leadership Act as Medison's primary representative and ambassador within the country. Build and sustain trusted relationships with key stakeholders including healthcare professionals, payers, regulators, government authorities, patient organizations, distributors, and strategic partners. Effectively communicate Medison's vision, value proposition, and strategic priorities to external stakeholders and partner organizations as relevant. Collaborate closely with global commercial teams and global leadership teams to ensure alignment between local execution and partnership expectations. Serve as a credible and influential healthcare leader capable of representing Medison with confidence, consistency, and one coordinated company voice. Organizational Leadership & Talent Development Build, lead, and inspire a high-performing affiliate organization with a strong culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and patient centricity. Develop future leaders and ensure robust succession planning across critical functions. Create an inclusive and engaging environment that attracts, develops, and retains top talent. Lead organizational transformation and capability-building initiatives required to support future business ambitions. Coach and develop the leadership team to strengthen business acumen, enterprise thinking, and leadership effectiveness. Compliance, Governance & Risk Management Foster a culture of ethics, integrity, compliance, and business accountability throughout the affiliate. Serve as the ultimate accountable leader for ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, industry codes, and company policies. Ensure risks are proactively identified, assessed, mitigated, and escalated where appropriate. Maintain inspection readiness and ensure effective management of business, regulatory, legal, compliance, and reputational risks. Requirements: Financial Accountability & Enterprise Thinking Demonstrated ownership mindset with full P&L accountability. Ability to make investment recommendations based on ROI, strategic priorities, and long-term business value. Strong financial discipline and understanding of business drivers. Enterprise perspective that balances local market needs with regional and global priorities. Ability to translate data, assumptions, and forecasts into sound business decisions. Commitment to transparency, rigor, and accountability in planning and reporting. Strategic Thinking & Business Gravitas Strong executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders internally and externally. Ability to proactively identify opportunities and risks and develop effective response strategies. Demonstrated strategic thinking, creativity, and business acumen. Ability to anticipate market changes and develop forward-looking plans. Strong decision-making capabilities in uncertain and ambiguous environments. Leadership maturity with the ability to inspire confidence, alignment, and action across diverse stakeholders. Partnership Management & Influence Strong partnership mindset with experience managing strategic alliances and external stakeholders. Ability to represent the company effectively with healthcare authorities, industry leaders, partner organizations, and customers. Excellent communication and storytelling capabilities, adapting messages to diverse audiences. Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments while maintaining alignment with company objectives. Strong Collaboration And Influencing Skills Across Matrix Organizations. Leadership Effectiveness Proven ability to build, lead, and develop high-performing teams. Strong coaching and talent development capabilities. Excellent interpersonal and cross-cultural leadership skills. Collaborative leadership style with the ability to lead without authority when required. High integrity and unwavering commitment to ethical leadership Other Skills And Qualifications University degree in Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, Business, Economics, or related field. MBA or other advanced degree preferred. 15+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry. Demonstrated success in senior commercial, market access, or general management leadership roles. Proven affiliate or business leadership experience with direct P&L accountability. Proven track record of product launches, reimbursement negotiations, strategic partnerships, and organizational leadership. Strong understanding of local healthcare systems, market access environments, and pharmaceutical regulations. Experience leading cross-functional organizations in complex matrix environments. Fluency in English and local language(s) where applicable. Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as required.

review_candidates.title: Country Manager - Home Appliance
review_candidates.description: About the Role As Country Manager, you will be the founding leader of our Spanish operation. You will establish the legal entity and go-to-market model, build the distribution network, ensure full regulatory compliance, and grow the business from launch to profitable scale. This is a start-up-within-a-corporation role for a commercially sharp, hands-on leader who understands the Spanish appliance and air conditioning landscape. Key Responsibilities Market entry and strategy Develop and execute the Spain market entry plan, including positioning, pricing, product range, and a 3-year business plan with P&L accountability. Conduct market and competitor analysis (Daikin, Mitsubishi Electric, Fujitsu, Panasonic, Samsung, LG, Midea, Haier, and local brands) and adapt the range to Spanish and European needs, including heat pumps, inverter technology, and low-GWP refrigerants. Advise HQ on product localization, packaging, labeling, and after-sales requirements. Distribution and channel development Build a multi-channel network: national and regional distributors, HVAC wholesalers, installer networks, electrical and DIY retail, large electronics chains, and e-commerce (including marketplaces). Negotiate distribution agreements, trade terms, and rebate structures in line with Spanish and EU competition law. Establish logistics, warehousing, and last-mile solutions, plus a spare parts and service network. Drive installer loyalty through training, certification, and incentive programs. Regulatory and compliance Ensure all products comply with EU and Spanish regulations, including CE marking, Ecodesign and Energy Labelling Manage WEEE and packaging producer obligations, including registration and membership of collective compliance schemes. Monitor developments such as RITE, building energy codes, and subsidy and energy-efficiency programs that affect demand. Oversee product liability, warranty (Spanish consumer law), and market surveillance obligations. Commercial and operations Set up and lead the local team (sales, key accounts, marketing, technical support, customer service, finance/admin). Manage forecasting, inventory planning, and supply chain coordination with HQ and manufacturing. Own local marketing: brand launch, trade shows (e.g., Climatización y Refrigeración), digital campaigns, and retail activation. Report KPIs regularly to regional leadership: sales, margin, market share, working capital, and service levels. Stakeholder management Represent the brand with key customers, industry associations, and regulators. Emmes has built industry leading capabilities in cell and gene therapy, vaccines and infectious diseases, ophthalmology, rare diseases, and neuroscience. We believe the work we do will have a direct impact on patients’ lives and act accordingly. We strive to build a collaborative culture at the intersection of being a performance and people driven company. We’re looking for talented professionals eager to help advance clinical research as we work to embed innovation into the fabric of our company. If you share our motivations and passion in research, come join us! Primary Purpose The Associate Director, Business Development is responsible for driving revenue growth by identifying, developing, and closing new business opportunities across Emmes' portfolio of clinical research services and technology solutions. This role serves as a strategic commercial leader responsible for positioning Emmes as a trusted partner capable of delivering end-to-end clinical development support through both its global CRO capabilities and its AI-enabled software platforms, data solutions, and digital technologies. This is a highly visible, externally focused role requiring a proven business developer who can engage pharmaceutical, biotechnology, government, academic, and healthcare organizations, uncover opportunities early in the buying cycle, and develop executive-level relationships that drive long-term growth. The Director will be responsible for selling standalone software solutions, CRO services, and integrated technology-enabled clinical research solutions. The ideal candidate combines deep life sciences industry knowledge with strong commercial acumen and experience selling complex services, SaaS platforms, technology solutions, or a combination of both. Responsibilities Business Growth and Revenue Generation Drive net-new business growth by securing new customers and expanding existing accounts across Emmes' CRO and software solutions portfolio. Meet or exceed annual sales, bookings, and revenue targets. Build and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities through proactive prospecting, networking, industry engagement, and strategic account management. Identify and influence opportunities before formal procurement processes begin. Develop and execute territory plans, account strategies, and pursuit plans aligned with Emmes' growth objectives. Integrated Solution Selling Position Emmes as a differentiated provider of both clinical research services and technology-enabled solutions. Sell CRO capabilities including clinical operations, data management, biostatistics, regulatory support, consulting, and therapeutic expertise. Sell software and technology offerings including clinical data platforms, digital trial solutions, AI-enabled analytics, data intelligence products, and operational technology solutions. Develop consultative solutions that combine services and software to address client business and research challenges. Partner with subject matter experts to create customer-specific solutions and value propositions. Strategic Client Engagement Develop relationships with senior-level stakeholders across clinical development, clinical operations, data sciences, IT, digital transformation, procurement, medical affairs, and executive leadership. Create and execute strategic account plans to maximize client growth and retention. Serve as a trusted advisor by understanding customer priorities, market challenges, and emerging industry trends. Lead executive meetings, capability presentations, client visits, demonstrations, proposals, and bid defense meetings. Market Intelligence and Opportunity Development Monitor industry trends, competitor activity, emerging technologies, and customer investment strategies. Leverage industry relationships and market intelligence to identify future clinical programs, digital transformation initiatives, and software adoption opportunities. Provide competitive intelligence and customer insights to commercial and executive leadership. Identify opportunities for expansion within strategic accounts through cross-selling and upselling initiatives. Attend industry conferences to promote the Emmes Group brand and network with potential clients, industry leaders and collaborators. Cross-Functional Leadership Collaborate with operational leaders, technology teams, product management, therapeutic experts, and executive stakeholders to develop compelling customer solutions. Lead internal pursuit teams and coordinate resources to advance opportunities through the sales cycle. Ensure alignment between sales commitments, solution design, delivery capabilities, and customer expectations. Contribute to the development of commercial strategies, pricing approaches, and go-to-market initiatives. CRM and Pipeline Management Maintain disciplined CRM practices and accurate forecasting. Track opportunities, customer interactions, pipeline health, and sales performance metrics. Provide regular reports on sales activities, pipeline progression, competitive trends, and revenue forecasts. Qualifications Required Skills and Abilities Strong understanding of the clinical development lifecycle and the evolving role of technology in drug development. Experience selling consultative, solution-based offerings that combine services and technology. Knowledge of clinical research, decentralized trials, data management, clinical operations, AI-enabled healthcare solutions, or related areas. Exceptional presentation, negotiation, relationship-building, and communication skills. Strong executive presence and ability to engage senior business and scientific leaders. Demonstrated ability to identify, qualify, develop, and close complex opportunities. Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills. Proficiency with CRM platforms, Microsoft Office Suite, and commercial reporting tools. Ability to work effectively in a matrixed, cross-functional environment. Leadership Competencies Commercial Leadership Demonstrates a proactive hunter mentality with a strong focus on revenue generation and market expansion. Creates opportunities through strategic networking, relationship development, and industry engagement. Maintains accountability for delivering measurable business growth outcomes. Strategic Thinking Translates Emmes' corporate growth strategy into actionable sales and account plans. Identifies emerging market opportunities and technology trends that can drive future revenue. Prioritizes opportunities that maximize long-term strategic value. Communication and Influence Communicates effectively with scientific, operational, technology, and executive stakeholders. Demonstrates consultative selling skills and the ability to articulate complex value propositions. Synthesizes customer feedback and market intelligence into actionable business insights. Collaboration and Teamwork Builds productive partnerships across business development, operations, product, technology, and executive teams. Drives alignment and accountability throughout the sales process. Contributes to a culture of collaboration, innovation, and customer success. Innovation and Continuous Improvement Promotes innovative approaches to customer engagement and solution development. Identifies opportunities to improve commercial processes and win rates. Champions the value of technology-enabled clinical research and digital transformation.
